en: Don't screw with me!!
Cold-blooded Luca, what's got you so angry?

jp: アタシはそんなことをしてまで
助かりたいとは思わない！
en: I don't want to be saved if that's what it takes!

jp: 何を迷うことがあるんだ？
en: It's just one brat to kill. What's there to hesitate over?
Shut up!

jp: まぁ、お前が手を下さなくても
en: Kukuku. Well, even if you don't do it yourself,

jp: 今頃ザイオンのヤツが
代わりにガキの始末を
しているかもしれないがな
en: Zion may be taking care of the brat in your place, right about now.

jp: アラギ・・・お前まさか
en: Aragi... don't tell me you told him about that!
Kukukuku
Aragi!!

jp: お前には、命の尊さを忘れぬ
戦士としての誇りは無いのか！
en: Have you no pride as a warrior, one who never forgets the worth of a life!

jp: 貴様がいつも引き連れている
化け物も、死体から作り
en: Those monsters you always drag around, you made them from corpses, didn't you!

jp: どうやって集めやがった！！
en: How did you gather that many!!
Relax. I didn't kill anyone from our village.
So you did kill your own kind!!

jp: オイオイ、悪魔が悪魔を襲ったら
いけないって決まりでも
en: Hey now, is there some rule saying a demon can't attack a demon?

jp: 本当に変わっちまったんだね
en: ...You really have changed.

jp: 昔はもう少しマシな奴だったよ
en: You used to be a bit more decent.
When was that?

jp: アタシがお前を終わらせてやる
en: For old times' sake, I'll be the one to end you.

jp: 気が短いのも相変わらずか
en: Short temper's the same as ever, too.
Fine. I'll take you on!
Young man
Bonjour
Cain
